author: 0C
why: the funding caliber of a model-input panel is the same class of object as the frozen normalisation statistics: changing it feeds the frozen weights something they were not fitted on. norm_stats got a hash; this is the panel's.

generation.blessed_because: the frozen king/s2 heads were fitted on the AS-TRAINED (un-normalised) funding caliber and have not been retrained since the 2026-07-25 fix
generation.flip_rule: this manifest is keyed to the generation hash ON PURPOSE. A retrain changes the hash, which fails the assertion, which forces a deliberate re-bless — the caliber expectation and the model version flip together or not at all.

exports/wide_dl_full.npz.role: the model-input panel the frozen heads were TRAINED on (built 2026-07-11)
exports/wide_dl_full.npz.file_sha256_note: bit-identity to this hash is a stronger statement than a re-measurement

exports/live/wide_dl_live.npz.role: the daily splice fed to the same frozen heads; must match the training caliber
exports/live/wide_dl_live.npz.file_sha256_note: rebuilt daily by design — no hash recorded; the measurement is the check
